This is about Space Engineers' blueprint paste mechanic, where players select a placement location before pasting a copied grid. I'm recalling that this involves the blueprint screen accessed via Ctrl+B, and thinking through whether the mechanics might have changed with updates since this is an actively developed game.…

Here's the process:

**1. Open the Blueprints screen** — press **F10**. This shows the list where your saved/copied grids live (local blueprints and Steam Workshop ones).

**2. Select your blueprint and load it to clipboard** — click the grid you want, then click **OK** (or "Copy to Clipboard"). That's the "select where you placed it" list you're describing.

**3. Bring up the ghost/preview** — press **Ctrl+V**. This spawns a translucent preview of the grid that follows your cursor/view.

**4. Position and rotate it** — move your view to place it where you want. Press **B** to cycle placement modes (gravity-align/90°, grid-align, free rotation), and use Insert/Delete, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown to fine-rotate.

**5. Confirm placement** — green outline means it's a valid spot, red means blocked. **Left-click** to actually paste it into the world.

A few catches:
- This only works freely in **Creative Mode**, or in Survival if you (or an admin) enable "Creative Tools" via **Alt+F10** (Space Master menu) first.
- In pure Survival without admin tools, you can't instant-paste — you place a **Projector** block, load the blueprint into it, and weld the projection block-by-block instead.
- If nothing snaps right, check the grid's pivot point (Info tab → "Show Grid Pivot") — an awkward pivot location makes alignment annoying.

Which mode are you in — Creative, or Survival with admin tools?

content.text:
After opening the F10 menu, select your blueprint and click "OK" or "Copy to Clipboard." Once in your clipboard, use Ctrl + V to bring up the ghost image. You can rotate this image using the Insert/Delete, Home/End, and PageUp/PageDown keys. Left-clicking will instantly spawn the grid into the world at no cost. In Survival Mode, you cannot instantly spawn a blueprint. You must build it block-by-block using a Projector block. This is the "Industrial" way to build. Placement: Place a Projector block on a stable platform or on the ship you are repairing. Selection: Access the Projector's terminal, click "Select Blueprint," and choose your file from the F10 list...

In Creative Mode, blueprints act as a free-form "Copy and Paste" tool. After opening the F10 menu, select your blueprint and click "OK" or "Copy to Clipboard." Once in your clipboard, use Ctrl + V to bring up the ghost image.

Alignment: Use the "Horizontal," "Vertical," and "Forward" offset sliders in the Projector terminal to move the hologram until it touches a physical block on your current grid.

The pivot point of a grid determines how the blueprint rotates and aligns when you attempt to paste or project it. In the Info tab, check the "Show Grid Pivot" box. If the pivot is in an awkward location (like ten blocks away from the actual hull), the blueprint will be difficult to align.

Here's the Xbox controller flow, confirmed from the community reports and official controller mapping:

**1. Open the Blueprints screen** — **RB + B**. This shows your saved grids/blueprints list.

**2. Select the blueprint** — highlight it and confirm with **RB** (same as picking a block in the build menu — RB confirms selection).

**3. Move to where you want it** — the ghost/preview follows your view. Line it up over the spot you want.

**4. Place it** — **Right Trigger (RT)**.

A couple of things that trip people up on console specifically:

- **Rotating the preview**: D-pad left/right rotates it before you drop it. If it won't line up how you want, there's a lock/align toggle (B on keyboard = toggle bounding-box lock vs. free-align) — on controller this is one of the modifier presses, so if rotation feels "stuck" to 90°, you're in the grid/gravity-align mode rather than free placement.
- **Survival mode**: you can't just paste directly like in Creative. You need **Admin/Space Master tools enabled** first (if you're the admin or on a world where that's allowed), or you build it the "legal" way through a **Projector** block instead.
- A common console complaint: hitting "copy to clipboard" seems to do nothing at first — it's not instant, wait a beat for it to load before the ghost preview shows up green.

The answer is, use blueprints (F10 key)! A blueprint stores all blocks and their names and positions, their colour and skins, their control panel configuration and PB scripts, the toolbar actions and groups, DLC blocks and modded blocks. You can create blueprints in Survival and in Creative worlds. 

Blueprints are the best way to design ships in one world and recreate them in another: When Creative-style Copy and Paste is not enabled in the World Settings, Blueprint projections are a "legal" in-game way to allow players to transfer grids between worlds of any type (with some limitations). Other players have created and shared great things!

Hitting B on the keyboard changes the block placement/ pas

Here's the Xbox controller flow, confirmed from the community reports and official controller mapping:

**1. Open the Blueprints screen** — **RB + B**. This shows your saved grids/blueprints list.

**2. Select the blueprint** — highlight it and confirm with **RB** (same as picking a block in the build menu — RB confirms selection).

**3. Move to where you want it** — the ghost/preview follows your view. Line it up over the spot you want.

**4. Place it** — **Right Trigger (RT)**.

A couple of things that trip people up on console specifically:

- **Rotating the preview**: D-pad left/right rotates it before you drop it. If it won't line up how you want, there's a lock/align toggle (B on keyboard = toggle bounding-box lock vs. free-align) — on controller this is one of the modifier presses, so if rotation feels "stuck" to 90°, you're in the grid/gravity-align mode rather than free placement.
- **Survival mode**: you can't just paste directly like in Creative. You need **Admin/Space Master tools enabled** first (if you're the admin or on a world where that's allowed), or you build it the "legal" way through a **Projector** block instead.
- A common console complaint: hitting "copy to clipboard" seems to do nothing at first — it's not instant, wait a beat for it to load before the ghost preview shows up green.

Are you trying to paste in Creative, or are you on Survival with admin tools?

chat_messages.text:
Yeah, that's a common annoyance — once a blueprint's "in hand" as a ghost, it feels stuck there.

**To drop it / cancel:**
- Go back into the same menu you used to grab it — **RB + B** to open the Blueprints screen again — and just close out of it, or select nothing / hit back out.
- Alternatively, switch your toolbar/hotbar slot to an empty one, or press whatever "clear hand" input you have bound (on PC this is often the **0** key to empty your hands — on controller, cycling your hotbar slots to an empty slot usually clears it the same way).
- If none of that clears it, opening your inventory (**Back button**) and closing it again sometimes resets the "holding" state too.

It's not actually locking you out of anything permanently — it's just occupying your "hand" like a held block would. Once you swap away from it or empty your hand, you're back to normal building/interacting.

Is it still stuck after trying that, or did one of those clear it?
